measurement.metric_semantics: A span is only an acceptance proxy for sustained useful work when continuous-progress evidence is also present; two sparse timestamps separated by idle time must never count as 14 minutes of work.
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: For a valid acceptance turn, ordered meaningful durable progress evidence must cover the run from substantive start through final progress with no unexplained internal gap greater than 120 seconds. Known waiting/idle intervals are excluded or invalidate the continuous-work claim.
measurement.dead_tail_definition: successor_or_handoff_boundary_at - last_meaningful_progress_at when both are known
measurement.target_operating_model: ~840s evidenced sustained useful work + ~60s runtime-safe handoff margin inside each intended 900s interval
measurement.platform_boundary_note: Official Scheduled Tasks documentation describes paid recurring schedules up to once per hour. The quarter-hour fast path is experimental same-task hourly-BYMINUTE mutation, so actual successor observation rather than nominal due time controls measurement validity.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: The prior epoch reached an observed 840-second progress boundary but did not commit its handoff; the following successor recovered only after the predecessor was already stale.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: Span-only measurement could falsely credit idle time between sparse timestamps; acceptance now requires continuous progress evidence with no unexplained gap >120s.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Removing redundant recovery grace for already-stale predecessors and requiring dense progress evidence will reduce baton latency while making the 14-minute target resistant to sparse-span false positives.
next_corrective_experiment.change: Use handoff-recovery v2 fast path; emit meaningful durable progress at <=120s gaps while working; record expected due and actual successor observation separately; finalize immediately on positive successor request.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: At least 3 valid completed turns with rolling mean observed_useful_span_seconds >= 840, each with continuous progress evidence, no voluntary dead tail, and no fresh-predecessor takeover.
